framework: Vite 8 + React 19 (app bootstrap in src/main.tsx, no router)
fontStack: Instrument Serif (display) + Switzer (body) + Commit Mono (outlier) — Google Fonts + Fontshare, loaded in index.html
palette: custom OKLCH custom properties in src/tokens.css; mirrored to WebGL in src/three/palette.ts
motion: motion-on for 3D only — react-three-fiber useFrame. No CSS animation library installed; reveal state uses IntersectionObserver
spacing: custom 4pt scale as --space-* custom properties in src/tokens.css
notes: The initial Vite scaffold shipped index.css with a #000/#fff dark-mode block and system-ui fonts. Both were replaced wholesale by the token system.
